HEADLINE: BRIEF-JPMorgan Says Outlook 2026 Net Interest Income About $103B - Presentation

BODY:
Jan 13 (Reuters) - JPMORGAN:

* JPMORGAN :OUTLOOK 2026 NET INTEREST INCOME ABOUT $103B - PRESENTATION

* JPMORGAN : OUTLOOK 2026 EXPENSES ABOUT $105B - PRESENTATION

* JPMORGAN : OUTLOOK 2026 CARD SERVICES NCO RATE ABOUT 3.4% - PRESENTATION

* JPMORGAN : OUTLOOK 2026 NET INTEREST INCOME EX-MARKETS ABOUT $95B - PRESENTATION
text: JPMorgan Chase provided its 2026 financial outlook in a recent presentation, projecting net interest income of approximately $103 billion, with net interest income excluding markets at about $95 billion. The bank forecasts total expenses of roughly $105 billion for the year. Additionally, JPMorgan expects its card services net charge-off rate to be around 3.4%. These figures offer investors a preview of the bank's anticipated revenue generation, cost structure, and credit quality expectations in its consumer lending segment heading into 2026, providing insight into management's expectations for profitability and risk amid the evolving interest rate and economic environment.
